head: Subscribe, run SETUP, play.
steps: Press Subscribe on the SEST Integration Pack and subscribe to all its required items. Let Steam finish.
In the game: Mod Manager, SEST Integration Pack, Open Folder. Then quit Sea Power.
It checks every mod is downloaded, installs the preloader and sets the load order, SEST at the top.
Southern Watch, Southern Reach, Red Line, Sulu Line, or Global Maritime Operations 2028 (Dynamic Campaign).
foot: On public beta 0.8.7-261107, a first install is SETUP, ten seconds at the main menu, quit, SETUP again.
If the Mod Manager offers to move dependencies above the pack, say no.
Run SETUP again (game closed) after the pack or a mod updates.

title: SOUTHERN REACH
subtitle: Tasman Shield
desc: Escort the Antarctic resupply season to the ice edge, then fight the same group from Fiordland through Cook Strait, the Tasman, Bass Strait and the Bight.

title: RED LINE
subtitle: The Other Watch
desc: The other side of the war, as the carrier group commander the Australians only hear on the radio.
counts:
6 missions and 3 side operations.
Won by restraint, deception, escort and evasion.

title: SULU LINE
subtitle: The Island Road
desc: Convoys, naval gunfire and the Balabac Strait. No free rearm: ships reload only from supply ships you buy and keep afloat.

Supply ships are sold three times.

title: GLOBAL MARITIME
subtitle: Operations 2028
desc: Command either coalition across the Atlantic, Mediterranean, Indian Ocean and Pacific. Fuel and ammunition are physical: guard the convoys.
counts:

8 command stages, 1,586 recruitment entries.
note: Needs Dynamic Campaign Mod, in the collection.
